title: Regenerate the GRUB boot menu configuration
summary: Updates the GRUB bootloader configuration file. This is necessary after installing a new kernel, changing boot options, or modifying /etc/default/grub.

aliases.text: не видно новую систему в grub

steps.explain: Generate the GRUB configuration file and write it to the standard location. This updates the boot menu.

alternatives.explain: Simulate the generation and print the result to the screen without saving, to check for errors first.

rollback.explain: If the new configuration breaks booting, you may need to restore a backup of /boot/grub/grub.cfg from before the change, or use a live USB to repair the bootloader.

warnings: Incorrect GRUB configuration can make the system unbootable.
Ensure you have a backup of /boot/grub/grub.cfg or a live USB available before proceeding.
